data.title: Descriptions — Starter · Lesson 4
data.subject: descriptions
data.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Alright now)

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
Nice to meet you… Mucho gusto
Let's talk… Vamos a hablar
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Getting to know you.

[Verse]
New neighbors just moved in
Across the street… al otro lado de la calle
Round face… cara redonda
Curly hair… pelo rizado
Blue eyes… Ojos azules
Smiling so bright… sonriendo tan brillante
Small nose… Nariz pequeña
Big mouth… Boca grande
They wave and say… nos saludan y dicen
"Hi there… hola"

[Hook]
Hello… Hola
Nice to meet you… Mucho gusto
Let's talk… Vamos a hablar
One, two, three… Uno, dos, tres
Getting to know you.

[Verse]
Thick eyebrows… Cejas gruesas
Long beard… Barba larga
Round glasses… Lentes redondos
Looking so cool… se ven tan geniales
Big smile… Grande sonrisa
Ugly dog… Feo perro
But lovable… pero adorable
We laugh and chat… reímos y charlamos
Under the sun… bajo el sol

[Bridge]
Colors of the day… colores del día
Yellow, blue, and gray… amarillo, azul y gris
